Name: Who Let That Dog Out
Author: Laurelore
Description:
[size=3]This Mod modifies the area of Dusty's enclosure, and is mainly an add-on to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20589]DustyNPC [/url]by Endwyr.
It adds a dilapidated wooden structure of unknown purpose as a perfunctory shelter over Dusty's flimsy cardboard box.[/size]
It also adds a water bowl, but removes the food bowl because food left in the sun and the elements like that is a health hazard, and surely the Mullners feed Dusty inside at designated meal times in a clean bowl.
[size=3]Every map/patch has been updated with Stardew 1.6's additional map layers and map tilesheets.[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=2]A[/size][size=2]nd every version has been visually reworked.[/size]

There are edits both for before and after the renovations of the enclosure:
At first you can either have my trashy dog shelter fenced in like in vanilla SV (or an edit of DustyOverhaul's dogpen if you use that) or you can have it standing alone in that vacant lot.
If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20589]DustyNPC [/url]installed, it should remove part of the vanilla fence to allow you access to Dusty's shelter. Both options now have a winter variant!
After Trash Panda's intervention, [size=3]this mod edits the food/water bowls and whether there are fences or not, depending on your mods. That one is configured in the config.json or through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/size]

[size=3][b]HowTo?[/b][/size]
[size=2]Made for Stardew 1.6[/size]
Make sure you got SMAPI and Content Patcher, 
Download the main file, unzip, put in your /Mods file or your preferred subfolder.
Optionally but preferably, go get Endwyr's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20589]DustyNPC[/url].
Enjoy this masterpiece of juryrigging carpentry with its adorable part-time occupant.



[size=3][b](In)Compatibility[/b][/size]

[size=3]Incompatible with other mods making changes to Dusty's enclosure:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2206]Free Dusty[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/886]More Space for Dusty[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVExpanded[/url] [/size][size=2](maybe? I don't use it so I haven't tested that)[/size]

[size=3]Except[/size]!
[size=3][b]Partially[/b] compatible [/size]with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10134]Domestic Animals[/url]:
 I do use Domestic Animals but I always [b]turn Dusty's changes off[/b] now that it's configurable.

But what if you want Dusty at your farm with[size=3] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13057]Dusty Overhaul[/url] [/size]you ask? Well it is also
[size=3][b]partially [/b]compatible[/size], because my mod doesn't affect the farm map.

!! [b]IS [size=3]compatible [/size][/b]with Endwyr's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20589]DustyNPC [/url]!!
In fact, I highly recommend it. I did make this mod because I wanted dusty roaming around. 

The following Town mods have been added as false dependencies to ensure that this mod here integrates seamlessly:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/177108672]NoraCharles[/url]' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20853]Town Tweaks[/url];
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3789]Convenient Town[/url]﻿.


If you need a recolor/compatibility patch or bug fix just ask and I'll look into it.

([url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/sallychan.770792/]sallychan [/url]for the [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/dusty-dog-mod-additional-color.130485/]sprite[/url].) [size=1]Should I make more alternative colours for great danes? My perfect barred rock chick turned out grea-nonono no time for that.[/size]
Go get [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6449395]Furbling's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20946]Alt Dusty Portrait[/url].

!Big Changes! If updating please delete old files first.

New Required Mod: Generic Mod Config Menu

A complete overhaul of the visuals, and I upgraded all files, including new patches for DustyNPC and Dusty Overhaul, to SV 1.6!

Will update the bugs soon.

Manifest.Name: Who Let That Dog Out
Manifest.Description: Perfunctory shelter for Dusty from a dilapidated wooden structure of unknown use. Gets him some water. No dog food out in the sun! He eats inside.
Manifest.Author: Auryline
